liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Jerry laughed at the reviewer's astonished expression during this song; The band loses cohesion coming out of the jam, then settles into a sweet Wheel [10][15]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Jerry plays with great fire on this song [15]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer recalls the Drums and Space as amazing, with sounds of all kinds everywhere [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-14.all.sbd.minches.108813.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 195 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1980-12-14.175909.nak700.ellner.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 186 min [3]
- **gd80-12-14.nak700.munder.13193.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 171 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the disc's sound quality great, with an unusual-feeling song mix; Overall quality is pretty good, but the recording is flawed toward the end of this song; Jerry's microphone is light in the mix on the opening songs Bertha, Greatest Story and Althea [10][11][15]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89058.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds full and deep, with rich bass and crisp highs, not thin or raspy [18]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak700.miller.89003.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 170 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [8]. Said about its sound: This transfer lacks the heavy noise reduction found on the shnid 13193 version [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first show, seen from first row center, with strong eye contact with the band [10]
- Reviewer attended from the second row, directly in front of Jerry [12]
- Flora Purim sang, with percussionist Airto Moreira also taking part [16]
- Matt Kelley joined the band on this song, and again on Around & Around [1]
- Airto and Flora Purim joined the band for the Drums segment [1]
- Matthew Kelly played harmonica on this song and on Around & Around [3]
- Airto Moriera and Flora Purim joined for Drums and Space [3]
- Matt Kelly joined on this song and on Around And Around [6]
- Suggests the drum sounds resemble the Horton Field House 1978 drums, from the same era as the Apocalypse Now sessions [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-14.all.sbd.minches.108813.flac1644**: transferred by David Minches; source: Unknown generation cassette from sound board master Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Cassette played back on Nakamichi Dragon> Korg MR-1000(DSF… [1]
- **gd1980-12-14.175909.nak700.ellner.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Ron Ellner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 (Maxell XLII-S90) provides "Bertha" through "Passenger", "Cold Rain & Snow > Samson &… [3]. Also: Master cassette by Ron Ellner using Bob Menke's equipment; Menke supplied the cassette and first-generation reel transfers; Charlie Miller coordinated [3]
- **gd80-12-14.nak700.munder.13193.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 700's [5]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89058.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [6]. Also: Made by Walker-Scotton and processed by Charlie; Recorded by Joani Walker near the soundboard area; tapes came via Walker and Paul Scotton [6][18]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak700.miller.89003.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M) -> Dat [8]. Also: Charlie Miller recirculated this source after noticing it was missing from the database [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rocktourdatabase.com: [Grateful Dead | rocktourdatabase.com](https://rocktourdatabase.com/concerts/grateful-dead-845) [25]
